author: Widogeist
body:
There is no "pay to win" aspect with Orna/HoA, runeshop items are cosmetic skins, and consumables (shrines, hammers, keys, etc) all of which can be found in-game just by exploring and completing dungeons.

It won't take long to reach endgame depending on how much you play, if you join a kingdom for raids, and share wayvessels with other players to use their dungeons and stuff. But I **highly** encourage you to take your time, enjoy progression, and learn the different classes rather than "rush to the end", because endgame is min/maxing gear and grinding ascension levels which contributes to burnout quickly (I've been playing this game for 6 years, trust me I know).

Events repeat throughout the year, so you'll be able to access any content you may have missed or were too low level to participate in.

As far as guides, [here](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aA4za2mOqvx1AosEIf9JmztPSTr5wh5wmfiaraL_YYw/edit?tab=t.0) is a spreadsheet that has a compiled list of various guides that players have created over the years. You can also go on the main [Orna](https://discord.gg/K6c7MBv3Ah) discord for other guides and advice.

Best of luck.

author: ChaoticDemise
body:
The game is F2P almost completely. The only items purchaseable are either cosmetics or items able to be found in game. The Archpaths give "more" rewards if you buy the key.

I have been playing 5 years. Didn't spend anything the first year. Then decided I love the game and I purchased a small thing every month or so just to support the devs and their team.

As others have said, all content will come back at some point so you won't miss out on anything. As for classes, if you make it to the end you will unlock all. Play around and see what you like best and go from there.

This is a grind heavy game so be prepared.

author: FluffLove
body: Events repeat so you havent missed anything. Not a super long grind to endgame if you can travel to boss farm around T6-7. Offhand arrows were super useful as a melee/thief character early on (T4 or T5 pvp reward), mage is possible youll just be buying lots more potions. Grind on friendo.
